europe_now.title: Ceuta border tensions between Spain and Italy
europe_now.summary: Spain imposed border controls on travelers from Italy amid a migrant row over Ceuta, escalating tensions between the two EU nations. The measures reflect a broader dispute over migration management and border enforcement policies.

sources.headline: Ceuta: Spain sets up border controls on travelers from Italy

top_stories.title: Ceuta border crisis
top_stories.summary: Spain has implemented border checks on Italy due to a migrant influx at Ceuta, intensifying diplomatic friction between the two countries. The situation highlights challenges in managing cross-border migration within the EU.
